title: WPT image tools (data/images/<name>/tools.json): the shared pool of working tools an attempt in the image may be offered beyond those its task needs, each answered by a program in the image (docs/post-training.md, "Tools")

schema.description: shape version of this file, for migrations

tools.description: declared as a task declares its own tools (task.schema.json)

description.description: what the model reads about the tool

parameters.description: the JSON Schema of the call's arguments

program.description: the absolute path, in the image, of the program that answers a call

names.description: other names an attempt may offer the tool under

looks.description: whether a call of the tool looks at sources, as read does (search, fetch, a file search); answered_by names only looking tools (docs/post-training.md, "The check library")
